items.title: Stem Cells and Derivatives in Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Mechanisms, Sources, and Therapeutic Perspectives.
items.authors: Antonio Cappa Spina; Pierluigi Puca; Sara Troisi; Valentina Petito; Letizia Masi; Greta Migliore; Cesare Pane; Simone Parello
items.abstract: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, are chronic, relapsing disorders of the gastrointestinal tract for which a substantial proportion of patients fail to respond to current therapies, underscoring the need for novel strategies. Mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) and their derivatives have emerged as a promising frontier in regenerative medicine, owing to their self-renewal capacity, multilineage differentiation, and potent immunomodulatory properties. MSCs modulate the intestinal microenvironment by suppressing effector T-cell responses, expanding regulatory T (Treg) and B (Breg) cells, polarizing macrophages toward anti-inflammatory phenotypes, reducing pro-inflammatory cytokines, and shaping the gut microbiota. Most of these effects are mediated by paracrine signals carried by the MSC secretome and extracellular vesicles (EVs), which deliver cytokines, microRNAs, and proteins that promote tissue repair, angiogenesis, and resolution of inflammation. Cell-free approaches based on conditioned medium or exosomes offer further advantages over direct cell transplantation, including improved safety, easier standardization, and reduced immunogenicity. MSCs derived from bone marrow, adipose tissue, and perinatal tissues each show distinct biological and therapeutic features. The treatment of complex perianal fistulas in Crohn's disease is the most clinically advanced application, with darvadstrocel demonstrating safety and efficacy in clinical trials. Additional emerging indications include intestinal fibrosis and tissue regeneration. Key challenges remain, including cellular heterogeneity, lack of standardized manufacturing, and optimization of dosing and delivery. Future perspectives point toward a paradigm shift from cell-based therapies to next generation cell-free strategies, including secretome-derived formulations and engineered extracellular vescicles, which may provide safer, more scalable and ultimately disease-modifying therapeutic options for patients with IBD.

items.title_cn: 炎症性肠病的干细胞及其衍生物：机制、来源和治疗前景。
items.abstract_cn: 炎症性肠病（IBD），包括克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎，是一种慢性、复发性胃肠道疾病，相当一部分患者对当前的治疗没有反应，这凸显了对新策略的需求。间充质基质细胞（MSC）及其衍生物由于其自我更新能力、多谱系分化和有效的免疫调节特性，已成为再生医学的一个有前景的前沿领域。 MSC 通过抑制效应 T 细胞反应、扩大调节性 T (Treg) 和 B (Breg) 细胞、使巨噬细胞极化至抗炎表型、减少促炎细胞因子和塑造肠道微生物群来调节肠道微环境。大多数这些作用是由 MSC 分泌组和细胞外囊泡 (EV) 携带的旁分泌信号介导的，它们传递细胞因子、微小 RNA 和蛋白质，促进组织修复、血管生成和炎症消退。基于条件培养基或外泌体的无细胞方法比直接细胞移植具有更多优势，包括提高安全性、更容易标准化和降低免疫原性。源自骨髓、脂肪组织和围产期组织的间充质干细胞均表现出独特的生物学和治疗特征。克罗恩病复杂肛周瘘的治疗是临床上最先进的应用，darvadstrocel 在临床试验中证明了安全性和有效性。其他新兴适应症包括肠纤维化和组织再生。主要挑战仍然存在，包括细胞异质性、缺乏标准化制造以及剂量和给药的优化。未来的前景指向从基于细胞的疗法到下一代无细胞策略的范式转变，包括分泌组衍生制剂和工程细胞外囊泡，这可能为 IBD 患者提供更安全、更可扩展且最终改善疾病的治疗选择。

items.title: Galectin-3 links microglial neuroinflammation to Aβ aggregation and lysosomal processing.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Lluís Camprubí-Ferrer; Jesús Soldán-Hidalgo; Emil Axell; Marzia Dell'Eva; Marta García-Cruzado; Juan García-Revilla; Yiyi Yang; Rosalía Fernández-Calle
items.abstract: Neuroinflammation is a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet the molecular mechanisms linking microglial dysfunction to amyloid-β (Aβ) pathology remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify galectin-3 (Gal3) as a regulator of plaque-associated microglial responses, linking Aβ aggregation, lysosomal function, and neuritic pathology. Using postmortem brain tissue from AD patients, we found that Gal3+ microglia preferentially associate with cored plaques and correlate with increased LAMP1+ dystrophic neurites. Gal3 was also detected in microglial lysosomal compartments, extramicroglial dystrophic structures, and in association with extracellular amyloid fibrils, suggesting roles in both intracellular and extracellular Aβ processing. In APP mice, Gal3 deficiency reduced plaque burden and neuritic dystrophy, increased plaque compaction, and enhanced TREM2 coverage around amyloid plaques. Mechanistically, in vitro microglial experiments showed that Gal3 modulates Aβ uptake and lysosomal processing, whereas lysosomal dysfunction promoted the accumulation of fibrillar Aβ from initially monomeric species, particularly in Gal3-deficient cells. Cell-free assays demonstrated that Gal3 preferentially binds fibrillar Aβ, inhibits secondary nucleation, and alters fibril morphology, while Gal3-modified fibrillar Aβ reduces N2a neuronal cell number. Finally, in silico structural analyses identified candidate Gal3 interactors enriched in leucine-rich-repeat and immunoglobulin-like proteins, supporting a role for this lectin in immune receptor regulation. Complementary in vivo transcriptomic profiling showed that Gal3 deletion suppresses type I interferon and microglial neurodegenerative transcriptional signatures. Together, these findings position Gal3 at the interface between Aβ remodeling, lysosomal homeostasis, and plaque-associated microglial responses in AD.

items.title_cn: Galectin-3 将小胶质细胞神经炎症与 Aβ 聚集和溶酶体加工联系起来。
items.abstract_cn: 神经炎症是阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 的一个标志，但将小胶质细胞功能障碍与 β 淀粉样蛋白 (Aβ) 病理学联系起来的分子机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定半乳糖凝集素 3 (Gal3) 是斑块相关小胶质细胞反应的调节剂，将 Aβ 聚集、溶酶体功能和神经炎病理学联系起来。使用 AD 患者死后脑组织，我们发现 Gal3+ 小胶质细胞优先与核心斑块相关，并与 LAMP1+ 营养不良性神经突增加相关。 Gal3 还在小胶质细胞溶酶体区室、小胶质细胞外营养不良结构中检测到，并与细胞外淀粉样原纤维相关，表明其在细胞内和细胞外 Aβ 加工中发挥作用。在 APP 小鼠中，Gal3 缺乏减少了斑块负担和神经炎性营养不良，增加了斑块压实度，并增强了淀粉样斑块周围 TREM2 的覆盖。从机制上讲，体外小胶质细胞实验表明，Gal3 调节 Aβ 摄取和溶酶体加工，而溶酶体功能障碍促进了最初单体形式的纤维状 Aβ 的积累，特别是在 Gal3 缺陷的细胞中。无细胞测定表明，Gal3 优先结合纤维状 Aβ，抑制二次成核，并改变纤维形态，而 Gal3 修饰的纤维状 Aβ 减少 N2a 神经元细胞数量。最后，通过计算机结构分析确定了富含亮氨酸重复序列和免疫球蛋白样蛋白的候选 Gal3 相互作用蛋白，支持了这种凝集素在免疫受体调节中的作用。补充体内转录组分析表明 Gal3 缺失抑制 I 型干扰素和小胶质细胞神经退行性转录特征。总之，这些发现将 Gal3 定位在 AD 中 Aβ 重塑、溶酶体稳态和斑块相关小胶质细胞反应之间的界面。

items.title: Intranasal delivery of a ROS-activatable myeloperoxidase inhibitor alleviates Alzheimer's-like symptoms and pathology.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Jing Wang; Peilin Cong; Enduo Feng; Matthias W G Zeller; Boyu Zhang; Yifan Lv; Negin Jalali Motlagh; Jenny Linnoila
items.abstract: Chronic neuroinflammation and oxidative stress are important contributors to Alzheimer's disease (AD). Myeloperoxidase (MPO), a key driver of oxidative inflammation released mainly by activated microglia in the neurodegenerative brain, is a potential therapeutic target to inhibit the neuroinflammatory cascade and oxidative damage in AD, but the underlying mechanisms remain unexplored, and achieving targeted brain delivery of an MPO inhibitor and minimizing systemic effects remain significant challenges. We addressed these limitations by first establishing that genetic deletion of MPO in the 5XFAD mouse model improved memory performance and reduced amyloid deposition, validating MPO as a therapeutic target. We then developed a liposome-encapsulated reactive oxygen species (ROS)-activatable MPO inhibitor (LERAMI). LERAMI uniquely combines targeted delivery with on-demand drug release, utilizing a ROS-sensitive linker to selectively release MPO inhibitors in ROS-rich regions within the AD microenvironment, minimizing off-target effects and systemic toxicity. In the 5XFAD mouse model. By reducing MPO expression and activity, LERAMI significantly improved cognitive performance, accompanied by decreased microglial activation, attenuated oxidative DNA damage, improved synaptic and neuronal density, and reduced amyloid burden. RNA sequencing revealed a robust hippocampal transcriptomic reprogramming, with upregulation of pathways critical for synaptic plasticity, calcium signaling, axon guidance, and neuroprotection, along with downregulation of inflammatory and immune response pathways. These findings demonstrate that targeted ROS-activatable MPO inhibition with LERAMI represents a promising therapeutic strategy for AD and potentially other neuroinflammatory diseases, offering a unique approach to mitigate neuroinflammation, preserve synaptic integrity, and restore cognitive function.

items.title_cn: 鼻内递送 ROS 可激活的髓过氧化物酶抑制剂可减轻阿尔茨海默病样症状和病理。
items.abstract_cn: 慢性神经炎症和氧化应激是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的重要诱因。髓过氧化物酶 (MPO) 是神经退行性大脑中主要由激活的小胶质细胞释放的氧化炎症的关键驱动因素，是抑制 AD 中神经炎症级联和氧化损伤的潜在治疗靶点，但其潜在机制仍未被探索，实现 MPO 抑制剂的靶向大脑递送和最小化全身影响仍然是重大挑战。我们通过首先确定 5XFAD 小鼠模型中 MPO 的基因缺失改善了记忆性能并减少了淀粉样蛋白沉积，从而解决了这些局限性，从而验证了 MPO 作为治疗靶点。然后，我们开发了一种脂质体封装的活性氧 (ROS) 可激活的 MPO 抑制剂 (LERAMI)。 LERAMI 独特地将靶向递送与按需药物释放相结合，利用 ROS 敏感连接体在 AD 微环境中富含 ROS 的区域选择性地释放 MPO 抑制剂，从而最大限度地减少脱靶效应和全身毒性。在 5XFAD 鼠标型号中。通过降低 MPO 表达和活性，LERAMI 显着改善认知能力，同时减少小胶质细胞活化，减轻氧化 DNA 损伤，改善突触和神经元密度，并减少淀粉样蛋白负担。 RNA测序揭示了海马体转录组重编程，对突触可塑性、钙信号传导、轴突引导和神经保护至关重要的通路上调，同时炎症和免疫反应通路下调。这些发现表明，LERAMI 靶向 ROS 可激活的 MPO 抑制代表了治疗 AD 和其他潜在神经炎症性疾病的一种有前途的治疗策略，为减轻神经炎症、保持突触完整性和恢复认知功能提供了独特的方法。

items.title: Inhibition of NLRP3 maintains microglial architecture and enhances neurological recovery after traumatic brain injury.
items.authors: Sergio Castro-Gomez; Luis José Medina-Centanaro; Juan Ignacio Muñoz-Manco; Ana Vieira-Saecker; Sharumathi Jeyasankar; Ida Kulińska; Tao Li; Felix D Weiss
items.abstract: The NLR family pyrin domain containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome orchestrates neuroinflammation, but its role in traumatic brain injury (TBI) and the therapeutic value of pharmacological inhibition remain incompletely defined. Using Nlrp3-deficient mice and two novel orally bioavailable selective antagonists (NP3-253 and NP3-361), we investigate NLRP3-dependent mechanisms of post-traumatic neuroinflammation and functional recovery. After controlled cortical impact, NLRP3 inflammasome components, pro-inflammatory genes, and mediators are robustly upregulated during the first post-injury week. Genetic Nlrp3 deletion and post-TBI NP3-253 treatment preserve microglial architecture and reduce aggregation and redistribution of the inflammasome adaptor apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a CARD (ASC), while post-TBI NP3-253 and NP3-361 therapeutically accelerate neurological recovery during treatment. Longitudinal intravital imaging shows that pre-TBI NLRP3 inhibition with NP3-361 constrains post-traumatic microglial activation in vivo. These findings establish NLRP3 as a driver of post-traumatic microglial morphodynamics and support selective NLRP3 inhibition as a promising strategy to improve neurological outcomes after TBI.

items.title: Neuronal IL-34 programs microglial activity via the TGF-β-MEF2C axis to constrain neuroinflammation following brain ischemia.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Minshu Li; Xu Zhou; Ran Li; Hanchen Liu; Caiyun Qi; Wenjun Zhang; Yali Han; Tingyu Yin
items.abstract: Brain ischemia induces robust neuroinflammation driven by microglial activation, yet whether ischemic neurons actively reprogram microglial phenotypes to limit inflammation remains elusive. Here, we identify neuronal interleukin-34 (IL-34) as a critical immunomodulatory signal that maintains microglial homeostasis after cerebral ischemia. We demonstrate that ischemic injury augments IL-34-CSF1R signaling between neurons and microglia. Neuron-specific overexpression of Il34 (Syn1-Il34tg mice) attenuated infarct volume and neurodeficits after middle cerebral artery occlusion, whereas neuronal Il34 knockdown exacerbated brain injury. Microglial depletion abolished IL-34-mediated neuroprotection, suggesting microglia as essential effectors. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that neuronal IL-34 preserved homeostatic microglial signatures (P2ry12, Cx3cr1, Tgfbr1), while suppressing inflammatory activities (Il1b, Tnf, Cxcl2) through upregulation of the transcription factor MEF2C. Mechanistically, IL-34 activated TGF-β signaling in microglia and inhibition of TGF-β signaling abolished the protective effects of IL-34, whereas microglia-specific Mef2c overexpression rescued neuroprotection despite TGF-β blockade. Thus, ischemic neurons deploy IL-34 to orchestrate the immunoregulatory activity of microglia via the TGF-β-MEF2C axis, representing a previously unrecognized endogenous mechanism counteracting neuroinflammation. Our study reveals neuronal IL-34 as a potential therapeutic target for ischemic stroke.
items.title_en: Neuronal IL-34 programs microglial activity via the TGF-β-MEF2C axis to constrain neuroinflammation following brain ischemia.
items.title_cn: 神经元 IL-34 通过 TGF-β-MEF2C 轴编程小胶质细胞活性，以抑制脑缺血后的神经炎症。
items.abstract_cn: 脑缺血会诱发由小胶质细胞激活驱动的强烈神经炎症，但缺血神经元是否主动重新编程小胶质细胞表型以限制炎症仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们将神经元白介素 34 (IL-34) 确定为维持脑缺血后小胶质细胞稳态的关键免疫调节信号。我们证明缺血性损伤增强了神经元和小胶质细胞之间的 IL-34-CSF1R 信号传导。 Il34 的神经元特异性过度表达（Syn1-Il34tg 小鼠）可减轻大脑中动脉闭塞后的梗塞体积和神经缺陷，而神经元 Il34 敲低则加剧脑损伤。小胶质细胞耗竭消除了 IL-34 介导的神经保护作用，表明小胶质细胞是重要的效应器。单细胞 RNA 测序显示，神经元 IL-34 保留了稳态小胶质细胞特征（P2ry12、Cx3cr1、Tgfbr1），同时通过上调转录因子 MEF2C 抑制炎症活动（Il1b、Tnf、Cxcl2）。从机制上讲，IL-34 激活小胶质细胞中的 TGF-β 信号传导，抑制 TGF-β 信号传导消除了 IL-34 的保护作用，而小胶质细胞特异性 Mef2c 过表达尽管有 TGF-β 阻断，但仍能挽救神经保护作用。因此，缺血神经元利用 IL-34 通过 TGF-β-MEF2C 轴协调小胶质细胞的免疫调节活性，这代表了一种先前未被认识的对抗神经炎症的内源性机制。我们的研究表明神经元 IL-34 是缺血性中风的潜在治疗靶点。

items.title: SLC15A3 contributes to diabetic encephalopathy through enhancing mitochondrial lipoperoxidation-mediated microglial activation.
items.authors: Borui Zhang; Shengnan Liu; Jiangjing Li; Jiao Guo; Qiang Zhang
items.abstract: Diabetic encephalopathy (DE) is a common central nervous system complication of diabetes, characterized by cognitive decline and neuroinflammation. Mitochondrial dysfunction is closely implicated in DE pathogenesis, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, by intersecting published diabetes-associated microglial genes with mitophagy-related genes, we identified SLC15A3, which was highly expressed in microglia. SLC15A3 overexpression induced microglial activation, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation, manifested by increased IBA-1 expression, enhanced migration, elevated ROS and MDA levels, and upregulated pro-inflammatory cytokines. Conversely, SLC15A3 knockdown effectively reversed high glucose (HG)-induced microglial oxidative stress and inflammatory activation. Mechanistically, Nucleotide-binding Oligomerization Domain-containing protein 2 (NOD2) was identified as a candidate interacting protein of SLC15A3. SLC15A3 upregulated NOD2 expression to activate the downstream JNK/DRP1 signaling axis, thereby aggravating mitochondrial lipid peroxidation, reducing mitochondrial membrane potential, and triggering aberrant PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitophagy dysregulation. Notably, JNK knockdown significantly rescued SLC15A3-induced mitochondrial dysfunction. Importantly, this SLC15A3-NOD2 regulatory axis was further validated in primary murine microglia. In a microglia-endothelial co-culture blood-brain barrier (BBB) model, SLC15A3 silencing alleviated HG-evoked BBB permeability damage and restored the expression of tight junction proteins. In vivo hippocampal knockdown of SLC15A3 or NOD2 mitigated BBB disruption, reduced neuronal apoptosis, and partially attenuated cognitive deficits in DE mice. Collectively, this study demonstrates that SLC15A3 facilitated mitochondrial lipid peroxidation and mitophagy dysregulation via a NOD2-dependent JNK/DRP1 pathway, thereby accelerating BBB injury and DE progression. SLC15A3 represents a potential therapeutic target for diabetic cognitive complications.

items.abstract_cn: 糖尿病脑病（DE）是糖尿病常见的中枢神经系统并发症，以认知能力下降和神经炎症为特征。线粒体功能障碍与 DE 发病机制密切相关，但其潜在机制仍知之甚少。在这里，通过将已发表的糖尿病相关小胶质细胞基因与线粒体自噬相关基因相交叉，我们鉴定出了在小胶质细胞中高度表达的 SLC15A3。 SLC15A3 过表达诱导小胶质细胞激活、氧化应激和神经炎症，表现为 IBA-1 表达增加、迁移增强、ROS 和 MDA 水平升高以及促炎细胞因子上调。相反，SLC15A3敲低有效逆转高葡萄糖（HG）诱导的小胶质细胞氧化应激和炎症激活。从机制上讲，含核苷酸结合寡聚化结构域的蛋白 2 (NOD2) 被鉴定为 SLC15A3 的候选相互作用蛋白。 SLC15A3上调NOD2表达，激活下游JNK/DRP1信号轴，从而加剧线粒体脂质过氧化，降低线粒体膜电位，并引发异常的PINK1/Parkin依赖性线粒体自噬失调。值得注意的是，JNK 敲低显着挽救了 SLC15A3 诱导的线粒体功能障碍。重要的是，这种 SLC15A3-NOD2 调节轴在原代小鼠小胶质细胞中得到了进一步验证。在小胶质细胞-内皮共培养血脑屏障 (BBB) 模型中，SLC15A3 沉默减轻了 HG 引起的 BBB 通透性损伤，并恢复了紧密连接蛋白的表达。体内海马区 SLC15A3 或 NOD2 敲低可减轻 DE 小鼠的 BBB 破坏、减少神经元凋亡并部分减轻认知缺陷。总的来说，这项研究表明，SLC15A3 通过 NOD2 依赖性 JNK/DRP1 途径促进线粒体脂质过氧化和线粒体自噬失调，从而加速 BBB 损伤和 DE 进展。 SLC15A3代表了糖尿病认知并发症的潜在治疗靶点。

items.title: Stem Cell and Extracellular Vesicle Therapies for Subarachnoid Hemorrhage: Pathophysiology, Preclinical Evidence, and Translational Challenges.
items.authors: Naser Hamad; Omar Altabbakh; Sean O'Leary; Muhammad Azhar; Abdullah Durrani; Caleigh Roach; Quinn Jackson; Tiffany A Eatz
items.abstract: Subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) remains a devastating neurological condition with high mortality and morbidity, largely due to secondary brain injury mechanisms such as early brain injury (EBI) and secondary white matter injury (SWMI). Conventional surgical and medical interventions have not been sufficient to prevent long-term disability, prompting investigation into novel regenerative strategies. We conducted a narrative review of preclinical and limited clinical evidence on stem cell- and extracellular vesicle/exosome-based therapies for SAH, with emphasis on MSCs and their derivatives. PubMed/MEDLINE and Embase were searched between February and March 2025 for studies examining mechanisms, therapeutic targets, dosing, timing, and routes of administration. Stem cell-based therapies, particularly MSCs and their exosomes, have shown the ability to attenuate neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, excitotoxicity, and BBB disruption. Key mechanisms include modulation of the HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB axis, polarization of microglia toward an anti-inflammatory phenotype, and secretion of trophic factors such as TSG-6, BDNF, and NT-3. Preclinical studies demonstrate improvements in neurological function, cognitive outcomes, and histological preservation across multiple SAH models. Exosome delivery of microRNAs (e.g., miR-129-5p, miR-193b-3p) has emerged as a potent cell-free strategy. Benefits have been reported after both early and delayed administration; however, differences in experimental models, therapeutic products, dosing methods, routes of administration, and outcome measures prevent direct cross-study comparisons and preclude identification of an optimal treatment window. MSC-derived therapies, hold significant promise for mitigating secondary injury and improving outcomes after SAH. Despite this promise, significant translational challenges concerning optimal dosing, delivery methods, and long-term safety must still be addressed. The path to clinical use requires rigorous validation in large animal models before advancing to human trials. Such validation may support the future clinical development of stem cell-based therapies for SAH.

items.title_cn: 蛛网膜下腔出血的干细胞和细胞外囊泡疗法：病理生理学、临床前证据和转化挑战。
items.abstract_cn: 蛛网膜下腔出血（SAH）仍然是一种具有高死亡率和发病率的破坏性神经系统疾病，很大程度上是由于继发性脑损伤机制，例如早期脑损伤（EBI）和继发性白质损伤（SWMI）。传统的手术和医疗干预措施不足以预防长期残疾，促使人们研究新的再生策略。我们对基于干细胞和细胞外囊泡/外泌体的 SAH 疗法的临床前和有限的临床证据进行了叙述性回顾，重点是间充质干细胞及其衍生物。在 2025 年 2 月至 3 月期间检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE 和 Embase，以查找检查机制、治疗目标、剂量、时间和给药途径的研究。基于干细胞的疗法，特别是间充质干细胞及其外泌体，已显示出减轻神经炎症、氧化应激、兴奋性毒性和血脑屏障破坏的能力。关键机制包括 HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB 轴的调节、小胶质细胞向抗炎表型的极化以及 TSG-6、BDNF 和 NT-3 等营养因子的分泌。临床前研究表明，多种 SAH 模型的神经功能、认知结果和组织学保存均有所改善。外泌体递送 microRNA（例如 miR-129-5p、miR-193b-3p）已成为一种有效的无细胞策略。早期和延迟给药后均报告有益处；然而，实验模型、治疗产品、给药方法、给药途径和结果测量的差异阻碍了直接的交叉研究比较，并妨碍了最佳治疗窗口的确定。间充质干细胞衍生的疗法对于减轻蛛网膜下腔出血后的继发性损伤和改善预后具有重大前景。尽管有这一承诺，但仍必须解决有关最佳剂量、给药方法和长期安全性的重大转化挑战。临床使用之路需要在进入人体试验之前在大型动物模型中进行严格验证。这种验证可能支持未来基于干细胞的 SAH 疗法的临床开发。

items.title: Remodeling of synaptome architecture following traumatic brain injury.
items.authors: Aimun A B Jamjoom; Ragini Gokhale; Jonathan Rhodes; Zhen Qiu; Seth G N Grant
items.abstract: In the brain, excitatory synapse diversity is organized into a brainwide synaptome architecture. Traumatic brain injury is associated with synapse loss, but its impact upon synaptome architecture is unknown. Using synaptome mapping across 222 brain regions in mice, we show that lateral fluid percussion injury induces a progressive and distributed reorganization of excitatory synapse populations over 28 days. Although whole-brain synapse number is preserved, specific molecular types and subtypes of synapses exhibit region- and time-dependent vulnerability. At 7 days after injury, synapse types with rapid turnover of the postsynaptic scaffold protein PSD95 are preferentially reduced. However, by 28 days, they have increased, whereas those synapses with slow turnover are reduced. Microglial activation correlated with this synaptome remodeling in a temporally structured manner. These findings reveal a two-phase, proteostasis-linked reprogramming of synaptome architecture, suggesting that large-scale rebalancing of molecularly distinct synapse populations is a general mechanism underlying injury-induced brain plasticity.

items.title_cn: 创伤性脑损伤后突触体结构的重塑。
items.abstract_cn: 在大脑中，兴奋性突触多样性被组织成全脑突触体结构。创伤性脑损伤与突触丢失有关，但其对突触体结构的影响尚不清楚。通过对小鼠 222 个大脑区域的突触组图谱进行分析，我们发现横向液体冲击损伤会在 28 天内诱导兴奋性突触群的渐进性和分布式重组。尽管全脑突触数量得以保留，但突触的特定分子类型和亚型表现出区域和时间依赖性的脆弱性。损伤后 7 天，突触后支架蛋白 PSD95 快速更新的突触类型优先减少。然而，到了 28 天，它们有所增加，而那些周转缓慢的突触却减少了。小胶质细胞激活与这种突触体重塑以时间结构的方式相关。这些发现揭示了突触体结构的两阶段、与蛋白质稳态相关的重编程，表明分子上不同的突触群的大规模重新平衡是损伤引起的大脑可塑性的一般机制。

items.title: Encapsulated Extracellular Vesicles Derived from Stem Cells as a Novel Therapeutic Approach in Regenerative Medicine.
items.authors: Seyedeh Parya Farboud; Raheleh Farahzadi; Kulmira Nurgali; Behnaz Valipour; Ezzatollah Fathi
items.abstract: Stem cells are encouraging tools in regenerative medicine because of their ability to induce tissue formation and promote organ repair, which has indicated noticeable potential to control certain diseases. Despite promising results and potential for stem cell microencapsulation, there are still several challenges and issues remaining, such as comparatively low viability of encapsulated cells. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are being chiefly investigated with regard to their fundamental role in cell-to-cell communication and their involvement as acellular therapeutics in regenerative medicine. They can also carry a large number of molecules (including DNA, RNA species, lipids, and proteins) and might be used as biomarkers for diseases. EVs derived from stem cells possess some advantages, such as non-infusion toxicity, free from tumorigenic potential and non-immunogenicity, easy storage and transportation, so they might be of interest for therapeutic purposes. However, their safety is not universally established and may depend on the parental cell source, purity, administered dose, EV cargo, and manufacturing conditions. Therefore, potential immunogenic, toxic, and tumor-promoting effects should be carefully evaluated through preclinical and clinical studies. In this review, we summarize current knowledge on stem cell-derived EVs and their possible application for the treatment of several diseases and have a brief discourse on encapsulation/ microencapsulation techniques.

items.title_cn: 干细胞衍生的封装细胞外囊泡作为再生医学的一种新型治疗方法。
items.abstract_cn: 干细胞是再生医学中令人鼓舞的工具，因为它们能够诱导组织形成和促进器官修复，这表明它具有控制某些疾病的显着潜力。尽管干细胞微胶囊化取得了有希望的结果和潜力，但仍然存在一些挑战和问题，例如胶囊化细胞的活力相对较低。人们主要研究细胞外囊泡（EV）在细胞间通讯中的基本作用以及它们作为再生医学中的非细胞疗法的作用。它们还可以携带大量分子（包括 DNA、RNA、脂质和蛋白质），并可用作疾病的生物标志物。干细胞衍生的EV具有一些优点，例如非输注毒性、无致瘤潜力和非免疫原性、易于储存和运输，因此它们可能会被用于治疗目的。然而，它们的安全性尚未得到普遍证实，可能取决于亲本细胞来源、纯度、给药剂量、EV 货物和制造条件。因此，应通过临床前和临床研究仔细评估潜在的免疫原性、毒性和促肿瘤作用。在这篇综述中，我们总结了目前关于干细胞衍生的 EV 的知识及其在治疗多种疾病中的可能应用，并简要讨论了封装/微封装技术。

items.title: Astrocytes contribute to long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid metabolism affecting microglia in fragile X syndrome.
items.authors: Dmytro Gerasymchuk; Karo Talvio; Andrew H House; Dimitri Meistermann; Alexey S Pospelov; Ilari Kousa; Hanna Ruhanen; Marja Koskuvi
items.abstract: Polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) influence membrane structure and function, energy metabolism, inflammation, and the ability to regulate microglial activity. We show involvement of astrocytes in long-chain PUFA metabolism in human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived astrocytes with fragile X syndrome (FXS). FXS astrocytes secreted more n-6 docosapentaenoic acid (n-6 DPA) and displayed a higher n-3 DPA to docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) ratio in medium than controls, consistent with an altered n-6 to n-3 PUFA balance in plasma from the FXS mouse. The FXS-specific increase in n-6 DPA secretion was abolished by treatment with all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA), which affected gene expression in astrocyte subpopulations and modulated secreted triacylglycerol species. Microglial exposure to n-6 DPA stimulated expression of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), which also tended to increase in microglia with reduced inflammatory marker expression when cultured in medium from ATRA-treated astrocytes. The results indicate that astrocyte-mediated n-6 DPA regulates the trophic functions of microglia in FXS.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Agent Orange Exposure and Diagnosis of Parkinson Disease and Related Disorders Among US Veterans.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Gregory D Scott; Miranda M Lim; Jonathan E Elliott; Lee E Neilson
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: IMPORTANCE: The risk of Parkinson disease (PD) due to Agent Orange, the Vietnam War Era defoliant, is inferred from studies of agricultural pesticide exposure. Epidemiological work is currently lacking. OBJECTIVE: To examine the association between Agent Orange exposure with incident cases of synucleinopathies including Parkinson disease, rapid eye movement (REM) sleep behavior disorder (RBD), and dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB) among US veterans. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This was an electronic health record-based cohort study inclusive of medical records from January 1, 1999, to December 30, 2022. Veterans were followed up for a mean (SD) of 12.5 (7.0) years from the start of records. Analyses were conducted from July 2024 to July 2026. The setting was the US Department of Veterans Affairs and included US veterans who served during the Vietnam War Era (August 1964 to May 1975) were screened. Those with incomplete demographic data or prevalent synucleinopathies before or within 6 months of follow-up were excluded. EXPOSURE: Agent Orange defined by self-report. Direct or occupational exposure was defined by involvement in Operation Ranch Hand, Army Chemical Corps, and/or direct handling or spraying. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Cumulative incidence of synucleinopathies was calculated adjusting for competing risk of death, age, traumatic brain injury, and frailty. RESULTS: After screening of 4 917 272 US veterans, 4 468 509 veterans (mean [SD] age, 60.6 [8] years; 4 380 139 male [98%]) were included in analyses. A total of 1 035 210 veterans (23.2%) had Agent Orange exposure; 7600 (0.2%) of these had direct or occupational exposure. Birth year, age at time 0 (start of records), sex, race, ethnicity, and smoking history were balanced among the exposed and unexposed groups with further adjustment for traumatic brain injury and frailty. Agent Orange exposure was associated with higher risk of PD (hazard ratio [HR], 1.44; 95% CI, 1.37-1.52), RBD (HR, 1.78; 95% CI, 1.68-1.89), and DLB (HR, 1.66; 95% CI, 1.32-2.09). top_journal_neuroscience.title: Hypersensitivity to adrenomedullin in post-traumatic headache: a randomized crossover study.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Haidar M Al-Khazali; Zahra Hakimzadeh; Anna G Melchior; Berkay Alpay; Ksenija Cucanić; Annette M Fuchs; Messoud Ashina; Håkan Ashina
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Adrenomedullin (ADM), a vasoactive member of the calcitonin peptide family with receptor-signalling overlap with calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP), has emerged as a candidate therapeutic target in migraine. Given the striking clinical parallels between migraine and persistent post-traumatic headache (PTH), we investigated whether ADM-responsive signalling contributes to migraine-like headache in adults with persistent PTH attributed to mild traumatic brain injury. We conducted a single-centre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, two-way crossover study in adults with persistent PTH and no pre-trauma history of migraine. On two experimental days separated by at least 7 days, participants received 20-minute intravenous infusions of ADM (19.9 pmol kg⁻¹ min⁻¹) and isotonic saline as the matched inactive comparator (placebo) in randomised sequence. Headache outcomes were recorded for 12 hours. The primary outcome was the within-participant incidence of experimentally induced migraine-like headache. The secondary outcome was the within-participant difference in baseline-corrected area under the curve (AUC) for headache intensity from 0 to 12 hours. Of 158 individuals assessed for eligibility, 21 were randomised, completed both periods and were analysed. Participants had a mean age of 34.3 years, 19 (90%) were female, and 18 (86%) reported a migraine-like phenotype. Migraine-like headache occurred in 17 of 21 participants (81%) after ADM and four of 21 (19%) following placebo. Fourteen participants developed migraine-like only after ADM and one only following placebo, yielding a paired absolute risk difference of 61.9 percentage points (95% CI 29.7-80.6; one-sided P < 0.001; two-sided P = 0.001). Baseline-corrected headache-intensity AUC was higher after ADM than placebo (median 1,110 [IQR 315-2205] versus 420 [-160 to 565]; P = 0.006). Median time to onset of migraine-like headache was 30 minutes after ADM and 390 minutes following placebo. Fifteen participants reported that the ADM-induced headache resembled their usual migraine-like headache episodes, and rescue medication was used by 10 participants after ADM and two after placebo. These findings identify pronounced responsiveness to ADM-linked signalling in persistent PTH and support the ADM pathway as a candidate target for mechanism-based therapeutic development, pending confirmation in independent cohorts and complementary preclinical studies.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Cortical and meningeal neuroimmune interactions contribute to the generation of migraine headaches.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Şefik Evren Erdener; Zeynep Kaya; Turgay Dalkara
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Migraine is a prevalent disorder that ranks as the second leading cause of disability among all diseases. Recent advancements have significantly enhanced our comprehension of its underlying pathophysiology. Growing evidence highlights complex neuroimmune signaling networks-particularly interactions between meningeal nociceptors and resident immune cells-as key contributors to headache generation. The clinical success of anti-calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) antibodies underscores the importance of intercellular communication between the dural nociceptive nerves and adjacent resident immune cells such as macrophages in migraine headache. Notably, the intercellular inflammatory interplay is not confined to the meninges. Disturbances within the brain parenchyma potentially act as initiating triggers, as suggested by the presence of aura and premonitory symptoms preceding the headache. Recent experimental discoveries indicate that neuronal stress triggers an inflammatory signaling cascade that, through interactions with astrocytes and microglia, propagates to the meninges, ultimately inducing meningeal neurogenic inflammation and headache. This model is supported by converging experimental evidence and human imaging studies employing PET and quantitative MRI, which document the presence of changes compatible with inflammatory activity within the brain parenchyma and overlying meninges of patients with migraine with aura. Genetic studies identifying several inflammation-related genes and pathways as risk factors for migraine further corroborate this concept. Furthermore, cell-specific transcriptomic analyses of mouse brains have revealed astrocyte-selective activation of nuclear factor kappa B -regulated inflammatory transcriptional pathways after cortical spreading depolarization, the neurophysiological correlate of migraine aura. Owing to their extensive interface with the cerebrospinal fluid, astrocytes are uniquely positioned to release inflammatory mediators to activate meningeal nociceptors and immune cells. Insights from pain research suggest that neuroimmune interactions may be responsible for the widespread parenchymal increases in 18 kDa translocator protein (TSPO) PET signals observed in migraine with aura patients. This discovery also identifies TSPO as a potential player in migraine pathophysiology and novel drug target. In this review, by integrating cellular and molecular findings from peripheral pain and inflammation research, we examine the dynamic interactions between neurons and glia, as well as between meningeal nociceptors and immune cells in the context of migraine headache. This perspective provides a conceptual framework for understanding how nociceptors and glial cells coordinate to signal non-homeostatic brain states-initiating protective, tightly regulated responses without progressing to overt neuroinflammatory disease and provides novel insight into the findings of PET studies involving TSPO.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 偏头痛是一种普遍存在的疾病，是所有疾病中导致残疾的第二大原因。最近的进展显着增强了我们对其潜在病理生理学的理解。越来越多的证据强调复杂的神经免疫信号网络——特别是脑膜伤害感受器和固有免疫细胞之间的相互作用——是头痛产生的关键因素。抗降钙素基因相关肽（CGRP）抗体的临床成功强调了硬脑膜伤害性神经与邻近常驻免疫细胞（例如偏头痛中的巨噬细胞）之间细胞间通讯的重要性。值得注意的是，细胞间炎症相互作用并不局限于脑膜。头痛前出现的先兆和先兆症状表明，脑实质内的紊乱可能会成为触发因素。最近的实验发现表明，神经元应激触发炎症信号级联，通过与星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的相互作用，传播到脑膜，最终诱发脑膜神经源性炎症和头痛。该模型得到了实验证据和采用 PET 和定量 MRI 的人体成像研究的支持，这些研究记录了先兆偏头痛患者的脑实质和上层脑膜内存在与炎症活动相一致的变化。遗传学研究将一些与炎症相关的基因和途径确定为偏头痛的危险因素，进一步证实了这一概念。此外，小鼠大脑的细胞特异性转录组分析揭示了皮质扩散去极化（偏头痛先兆的神经生理学相关性）后星形胶质细胞选择性激活核因子 kappa B 调节的炎症转录途径。由于星形胶质细胞与脑脊液有广泛的界面，因此具有独特的位置，可以释放炎症介质来激活脑膜伤害感受器和免疫细胞。疼痛研究的见解表明，神经免疫相互作用可能是 18 kDa 易位蛋白广泛实质增加的原因……

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Genome writing reveals SVA retrotransposon consequences in X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Weimin Zhang; Yu Zhao; Priya Prakash; Heather Appleby; Kelly Barriball; Simona Capponi; Qingwen Jiang; Aleksandra M Wudzinska
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Human retrotransposon insertions are often associated with diseases. Regarding neurodegenerative X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (XDP), a human-specific SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA) subfamily F retrotransposon was inserted in intron 32 of the TAF1 gene. Here, we genomically rewrote a portion of the mouse Taf1 allele with the corresponding 78-kb XDP patient-derived TAF1 allele. In mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), the presence of the intronic SVA-rather than the hybrid gene structure-reduces hyTAF1 (hybrid TAF1 mRNA) levels. This leads to transcriptional downregulation of genes with TATA boxes enriched in their promoters and triggers apoptosis. Chromatin and transcriptome profiling revealed that intronic SVAs are actively transcribed, forming barriers that likely impede transcription elongation. In mice, neuronal-lineage TAF1 humanization resulted in lethality in male progeny within 2 months. XDP male mice developed severe atrophy centered on the striatum-the same brain region affected in XDP patients. Lastly, CRISPRa-mediated activation of hyTAF1 restored mESC viability, suggesting that boosting TAF1 transcription could be a therapeutic approach.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Hypothalamic volume and cell-type changes in ageing and Alzheimer's disease.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Doudou Yu; Jürgen Germann; Ghulam Murtaza; Kaitlyn H Hajdarovic; Kelsey R Babcock; Shiva Kazempour Dehkordi; Alexander C Jackson; Ivana Delalle
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Alterations in metabolism, stress response, sleep, circadian rhythms and neuroendocrine processes are key features of ageing and neurodegeneration1,2. These fundamental processes are regulated by the hypothalamus, yet how its functionally distinct subregions and cell types change during human ageing and Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains largely unexplored. Here we present HypoAD, an atlas of the human hypothalamus in ageing and AD, including high-resolution magnetic resonance imaging from 458 individuals and single-nucleus RNA sequencing of 614,403 nuclei from young participants, patients with AD and age-matched non-dementia control participants. We show that hypothalamic subregions governing metabolism, stress and circadian rhythms are particularly vulnerable, showing notable changes in both volumes and gene expression during ageing and AD. At the molecular level, machine learning models identified the inflammatory response and regulators of circadian rhythms as key cellular predictors of AD. These signatures were reflected in specific cell types: microglia transitioned to a pro-inflammatory state, whereas inhibitory neurons within sleep-regulating and circadian-regulating hypothalamic subregions showed the most profound transcriptional alterations, including disruptions in ligand-receptor interactions and G-protein-coupled receptor signalling. HypoAD provides a high-resolution volumetric map and a transcriptomic atlas of the human hypothalamus in ageing and AD, relating lifestyle and behavioural changes to the relevant volumetric and molecular pathways. In addition, HypoAD provides a framework to investigate hypothalamic dysfunction and establishes a roadmap for targeted interventions aimed at mitigating physiological disruptions to potentially slow disease progression.

top_journal_neuroscience.title_cn: 衰老和阿尔茨海默病中下丘脑体积和细胞类型的变化。
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 新陈代谢、压力反应、睡眠、昼夜节律和神经内分泌过程的改变是衰老和神经退行性变的关键特征1,2。这些基本过程由下丘脑调节，但其功能不同的子区域和细胞类型在人类衰老和阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 过程中如何变化仍然很大程度上尚未被探索。在这里，我们展示了 HypoAD，这是人类下丘脑在衰老和 AD 方面的图谱，包括 458 名个体的高分辨率磁共振成像和来自年轻参与者、AD 患者和年龄匹配的非痴呆对照参与者的 614,403 个细胞核的单核 RNA 测序。我们发现，控制新陈代谢、压力和昼夜节律的下丘脑亚区域特别脆弱，在衰老和 AD 过程中，其体积和基因表达均表现出显着变化。在分子水平上，机器学习模型将炎症反应和昼夜节律调节因子确定为 AD 的关键细胞预测因子。这些特征反映在特定的细胞类型中：小胶质细胞转变为促炎状态，而睡眠调节和昼夜节律调节下丘脑亚区域内的抑制性神经元显示出最深刻的转录改变，包括配体-受体相互作用和G蛋白偶联受体信号传导的破坏。 HypoAD 提供了衰老和 AD 中人类下丘脑的高分辨率体积图和转录组图谱，将生活方式和行为变化与相关体积和分子途径联系起来。此外，HypoAD 还提供了一个研究下丘脑功能障碍的框架，并为旨在减轻生理干扰以潜在减缓疾病进展的有针对性的干预措施制定了路线图。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Microglia mediate motor memory decay through activity-dependent phagocytosis of myelin sheaths.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Zhechun Hu; Yujian Luo; Tingqi Zhou; Xuan Wu; Jiao Ma; Chao Wang; Liang Wang; Xiao-Dong Wang
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Experience-dependent changes in myelination are important for motor learning, with newly generated oligodendrocytes contributing to the formation of new myelin. However, motor memories decay over time and the underlying mechanisms remain largely unexplored. Here we show that motor memory decay is linked to changes in memory-associated myelin sheaths resulting from microglial phagocytosis in mouse brain. Mechanistically, reduced activity of motor memory engram cells lowers oligodendrocyte expression of the 'don't eat me' signal from Cluster of differentiation 47 (CD47), facilitating microglial phagocytosis and driving myelin loss. Knockout of CD47 from motor memory-associated oligodendrocytes increased microglial phagocytosis of myelin sheaths and accelerated the decay of motor memory, whereas overexpression of CD47 showed opposite results. Moreover, microglia phagocytose myelin sheaths and synapses independently. Our findings reveal that microglial phagocytosis of motor memory-associated myelin sheaths leads to the decay of motor memory. Since various types of memory require myelination in the brain, this mechanism may contribute to the decay of other memory types.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 髓鞘形成的经验依赖性变化对于运动学习很重要，新生成的少突胶质细胞有助于新髓鞘质的形成。然而，运动记忆会随着时间的推移而衰退，其潜在机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们发现运动记忆衰退与小鼠大脑中小胶质细胞吞噬作用引起的记忆相关髓鞘的变化有关。从机制上讲，运动记忆印迹细胞活性的降低会降低少突胶质细胞对分化簇 47 (CD47) 的“别吃我”信号的表达，从而促进小胶质细胞吞噬作用并导致髓鞘质损失。从运动记忆相关少突胶质细胞中敲除 CD47 会增加小胶质细胞对髓鞘的吞噬作用，并加速运动记忆的衰退，而 CD47 的过度表达则显示相反的结果。此外，小胶质细胞独立吞噬髓鞘和突触。我们的研究结果表明，小胶质细胞对运动记忆相关髓鞘的吞噬作用会导致运动记忆的衰退。由于各种类型的记忆都需要大脑中的髓鞘形成，因此这种机制可能会导致其他记忆类型的衰退。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: A cell-type-resolved proteomic atlas reveals intra- and intercellular signaling in Alzheimer's disease.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Xue Zhang; Jiyuan Yang; Kaiwen Yu; Him K Shrestha; Ying Zhou; Yun Jiao; Ju Wang; Ping-Chung Chen
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) arises from pathological interactions among diverse brain cell types, but cell-type-specific proteomic changes remain underexplored. Here, we present deep proteomic profiling of sorted or proximity-labeled brain cells from AD mouse models (5xFAD and AppNL-G-F) at multiple ages, quantifying 13,411 proteins in microglia, astrocytes, oligodendrocyte precursor cells, and neurons, with additional spatial information. We identified 3,028 differentially abundant proteins, most of which were absent in a bulk proteomic dataset, and constructed cell-type-specific networks to define functional modules and hub proteins. Comparison with transcriptomic data revealed that ∼30% of proteomic changes are RNA discordant. Further analyses uncovered cross-cell-type signaling proteins conserved in human AD brains, such as pleiotrophin (Ptn), which is transcriptionally enriched in astrocytes but accumulates in microglia. Importantly, recombinant PTN activates human induced microglia (iMG) cells. Thus, these findings provide a comprehensive cell-type-resolved proteomic atlas of AD models, highlighting novel intra- and intercellular signaling events.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Sex-dependent spatial organization of microgliosis tracks synaptic pathology in the demyelinated superior colliculus.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Jackson David McGrath; John Shultz; Maia J Classe; D Ford Hannum; Sebastian Werneburg
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Visual impairment is a common and clinically salient manifestation of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), yet pathology across visual system structures remains incompletely defined. Although the optic nerve, lateral geniculate nucleus, and visual cortex have been extensively studied, involvement of the superior colliculus (SC), a key visual processing hub, remains unclear. Here, we combined human postmortem tissue analysis with functional assessment and spatial mapping in the MS-relevant cuprizone (CPZ) mouse model to define how demyelination and secondary injury are organized within the SC. Postmortem SC tissue from donors with MS revealed myelin loss, including focal demyelinated lesions. In mice, CPZ impaired visual function and induced widespread SC demyelination without detectable neuronal loss or axonal degeneration. In male mice, although diffuse demyelination was accompanied by widespread microgliosis, atlas-based mapping uncovered a previously unrecognized spatial organization: a discrete high-microgliosis compartment with a stereotyped location and shape in every CPZ-treated mouse. This compartment did not correspond to canonical SC maps and was not explained by baseline microglial or myelin differences or by variability in local demyelination severity. Instead, high-microgliosis regions showed increased synaptic elimination, suggesting that secondary synaptic pathology may contribute to spatial organization of microgliosis beyond diffuse myelin loss alone. Prolonged CPZ exposure expanded the high-microgliosis compartment stereotypically, whereas withdrawal produced spatially ordered partial resolution with persistence of a high-microgliosis core and partial visual recovery. Former high-microgliosis territories showed partial restoration of synaptic density despite myelin recovery comparable to persistent high-microgliosis regions. In contrast, female CPZ-treated mice developed widespread SC demyelination and microgliosis without comparable compartmentalization, demonstrating sex-differential organization of microglial reactivity. Together, these findings identify the human SC as a site of demyelinating injury in MS and establish the CPZ-treated mouse SC as a sex-sensitive in vivo framework for investigating spatially patterned microglial reactivity, synaptic pathology, and incomplete resolution of microgliosis after demyelination.

global_hot_topics.title: Strategic Use of Peer-to-Peer for Organised Remediation Tutoring (SUPPORT). A Retrospective Analysis.
global_hot_topics.authors: Lucas G W Bloo; J Wouters
global_hot_topics.abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate examination outcomes and student experiences associated with a peer-to-peer remediation programme for undergraduate medical students with substantial academic delay. METHODS: A retrospective cohort study with an embedded qualitative survey evaluation was conducted. Medical students with at least one but less than two years of study delay were invited to join a voluntary peer-to-peer remediation programme. Examination pass rates after one academic quarter were compared between participants and non-participants using Pearson's chi-square test. Relative risks (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated. Participants of the programme were invited to complete an evaluation survey containing free-text questions, which were analysed qualitatively. RESULTS: A total of 69 eligible students were included in the study, all of whom were offered participation in the programme; 39 chose to join the programme (participants) and 30 did not (non-participants). Examination outcomes were available for all students. Participants had a higher pass rate than non-participants (20/39 [51.3%] vs. 8/30 [26.7%]; RR = 1.92, 95% CI 1.03-3.85; p = 0.040). A total of 23 participants completed the survey. The analysis revealed four key themes: perceived effectiveness and educational value; recognition, support, and psychological safety; need for broader and earlier implementation and organisation and logistics. CONCLUSION: Participation in the remediation programme was associated with a higher examination pass rate and positive educational, motivational, social, and emotional experiences. Earlier identification of struggling students and broader access to structured peer support may strengthen such programmes. Larger prospective studies with longer follow-up are needed to confirm these findings.

global_hot_topics.title: Longitudinal hemodynamic trajectories in severe symptomatic intracranial atherosclerotic stenosis under endovascular versus medical management.
global_hot_topics.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
global_hot_topics.authors: Ying Tan; Hanlin Chen; Mingyao Li; Ying Yu; Xiaobo Liu; Kai Zhang; Zhikai Hou; Ning Ma
global_hot_topics.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hemodynamic compromise plays an important role in stroke recurrence in patients with symptomatic intracranial atherosclerotic stenosis (sICAS). We aimed to characterize longitudinal CT perfusion (CTP) changes in patients with severe sICAS managed with endovascular treatment (EVT) or medical management (MM). METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients with severe sICAS (70%-99% stenosis) and recent ischemic stroke (<3 months) identified from a CTP database. Patients were grouped according to treatment received: MM alone or EVT plus MM. Baseline and follow-up CTP examinations were obtained at least 5 months apart. Changes in perfusion deficit volumes defined by relative cerebral blood flow (rCBF) and time-to-maximum (Tmax) thresholds were evaluated using adjusted longitudinal models. Propensity score overlap-weighted generalized estimating equation models were used for sensitivity analyses. Clinical events were recorded descriptively. RESULTS: Among 102 patients (44 MM; 58 EVT), perfusion deficit volumes defined by rCBF < 38% and < 34% significantly expanded in the MM group (both P = 0.018), whereas the EVT group showed no significant change. Primary adjusted analyses showed significant treatment-by-time interactions for rCBF < 38% and < 34% (both interaction P = 0.021). Overlap-weighted estimates remained directionally consistent but were not statistically significant (P = 0.162 and P = 0.160, respectively). The 1-year rates of target-territory recurrent ischemic stroke were 9.1% with MM and 8.6% with EVT. CONCLUSIONS: Primary adjusted analyses suggested different longitudinal rCBF trajectories between groups, but these differences were not statistically significant after overlap weighting. These findings should be considered exploratory and require confirmation in larger prospective studies.

global_hot_topics.title: Identification of Type 1 and Type 2 α-Synuclein-Seeds by CSF Seed Amplification Assay in Patients With Movement Disorders.
global_hot_topics.authors: Sandrina K Weber; Carly M Farris; Yihua Ma; Susana Schnell; Maritta Starke; Jens Ebentheuer; Jesusa E Kalinkara-Gomez; Michael Bartl
global_hot_topics.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: A novel α-synuclein (syn) seed amplification assay (synSAA) differentiates 2 types of syn-seeds in CSF: type1, associated with Lewy bodies (LBs), and type2, associated with glial-cytoplasmic inclusions, the hallmark of multiple system atrophy (MSA). However, syn-copathology extends beyond synucleinopathies, and copathologies are increasingly relevant. Different syn-seeds have been assessed in highly characterized research cohorts, but data assessing type and frequency in patients from routine clinical encounters are lacking. Hence, our objective was to determine frequency, type, and clinical association of different syn-seeds in CSF in a large cohort from a movement disorders (MDs) clinic. METHODS: This cross-sectional study included consecutive patients from a MD clinic between 2009 and 2025. CSF was tested with synSAA and clinical data derived from medical records. RESULTS: We recruited 1,059 patients (mean age 70.5 ± 10.5 years; 38.4% female; mean disease duration 4.0 ± 4.6 years). Syn-seeds were detected in 54.2% of patients, with type1-seeds predominating (88.5%). High synSAA positivity was observed in Parkinson disease (PD) (84.7%), dementia with LB (93.4%), MSA (84.5%), isolated REM-sleep behavior disorder (iRBD) (80.0%), and normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) with PD (87.0%). Undetermined hypokinetic MD showed 53.7% positivity. Moderate proportions (∼25-33%) were detected in Alzheimer disease, progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), corticobasal syndrome, and idiopathic NPH without PD, while other neurologic disorders showed 20.9% positivity. Type2-seeds were the major seed type in MSA (79.6% of syn-seeds) and minor type in PD (6.2%), PSP (9.1%), and undetermined hypokinetic MD (13.8%). Overall, type2-seeds were present in only 2.6% of non-MSA patients. Patients with type1-seeds had worse olfaction and more hallucinations. Multivariable regression identified impaired olfaction (OR = 0.67 per point increase of identified smells out of 12, higher scores indicating better olfaction) significantly associated with type1-seeds. DISCUSSION: Our results provide reference data on syn-seed frequency in routine clinical patients, demonstrating that type1-seeds indicate common underlying syn-pathology or copathology associated with hyposmia and hallucinations. Type2-seeds are specific to MSA and detection of type2-seeds outside the clinical MSA spectrum can improve diagnosis of patients with atypical presentations because our results match neuropathologic MSA studies. In vivo identification of different seed types will improve diagnosis, clinical trial stratification, and development of targeted therapies.

global_hot_topics.title: Label-free multi-metric pipeline for reproducible clustering of single-cell RNA-seq cell types.
global_hot_topics.authors: Zachary Yousef; Jonah Simone; Dylan Klein; Avinav Bhuyan; Heejoo Jen Cho; Priya Bhatt; Jiawei Wu; Hongyi Wang
global_hot_topics.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing has transformed our ability to identify cell types and explore cellular diversity. However, determining whether apparent cell subtypes represent true biological populations or artifacts of data analysis remains a major challenge. To address this issue, we developed scClustBench, an open-source benchmarking framework that evaluates cluster quality, stability, and reproducibility across multiple analytical approaches. Rather than relying on a single clustering method, scClustBench tests whether proposed cell subtypes can be consistently recovered. We applied scClustBench to a mouse retinal dataset containing bipolar cells, which are known to exhibit subtype diversity, and rod photoreceptors, for which subtype classification remains controversial. The framework consistently identified reproducible bipolar cell subtypes across analytical methods. In contrast, while some rod photoreceptor clusters appeared stable during resampling analyses, they could not be reproduced across embedding methods, suggesting that these partitions do not represent robust biological subtypes. Additional analyses using simulated and external datasets demonstrated that scClustBench reliably distinguishes meaningful cellular heterogeneity from analytical artifacts. These findings provide a practical framework for rigorous interpretation of single-cell transcriptomic data.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 单细胞 RNA 测序改变了我们识别细胞类型和探索细胞多样性的能力。然而，确定明显的细胞亚型是否代表真实的生物群体或数据分析的伪影仍然是一个重大挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了 scClustBench，这是一个开源基准测试框架，可跨多种分析方法评估集群质量、稳定性和可重复性。 scClustBench 不依赖单一聚类方法，而是测试是否可以一致地恢复所提出的细胞亚型。我们将 scClustBench 应用于包含双极细胞（已知具有亚型多样性）和视杆细胞（其亚型分类仍存在争议）的小鼠视网膜数据集。该框架一致地识别出跨分析方法可重复的双极细胞亚型。相反，虽然一些视杆光感受器簇在重采样分析期间显得稳定，但它们无法通过嵌入方法重现，这表明这些分区并不代表稳健的生物亚型。使用模拟和外部数据集进行的其他分析表明，scClustBench 能够可靠地区分有意义的细胞异质性和分析伪影。这些发现为严格解释单细胞转录组数据提供了实用框架。

global_hot_topics.title: Predicting outcomes in microdiscectomy surgery with applied machine learning.
global_hot_topics.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
global_hot_topics.authors: Jack L Roadley; Quinlan D Buchlak; Jainam Shah; Tony Goldschlager
global_hot_topics.abstract: BACKGROUND: Microdiscectomy surgery is a common procedure used to treat lumbar disc herniation (LDH), a condition causing significant lower back pain and sciatica. Despite its widespread use, outcomes vary, with some patients experiencing re herniation. Accurate prediction of postoperative outcomes could improve patient counselling and treatment planning. This study explores the application of machine learning models to predict re-herniation at 12 months using preoperative clinical and demographic data. METHODS: This multi-centered study used data from a randomised controlled trial involving 211 patients who underwent microdiscectomy. After addressing missing data, 152 cases were analysed. Logistic regression was first applied to determine significant covariates, followed by the development of supervised learning classifiers, including Random Forest, AdaBoost, and Neural Networks. Model performance was evaluated using metrics such as the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and area under the receiver operating characteristics curve (ROC-AUC). RESULTS: Significant predictors of re-herniation included smoking status and emergency department presentations. Smokers were 11 times more likely to experience re herniation, and those with frequent ED visits were 19 times more likely to do so. The Random Forest model achieved the highest predictive performance, with an MCC of 0.47 and an AUC of 0.69. Application of SMOTE improved sensitivity but decreased specificity in most models. CONCLUSIONS: Machine learning models, particularly Random Forest, demonstrated moderate predictive ability for re-herniation following microdiscectomy. Significant preoperative factors like smoking and ED visits were strongly associated with poor outcomes. These findings suggest that machine learning can enhance clinical decision-making by identifying high-risk patients, allowing for more personalised treatment strategies.

global_hot_topics.title: Engineered micro-nano system for ADSC-exosomes-based therapy of liver fibrosis via ROS elimination and PPARγ/PCK1 pathway reactivation.
global_hot_topics.authors: Wei Feng; Wei Zong; Yi Li; Xinyue Qin; Jing Qi; Guanhua Chen; Xuan Tan; Yiting Hou
global_hot_topics.abstract: Liver fibrosis is a progressive hepatic disorder driven by persistent oxidative stress and dysregulated transcriptional reprogramming of hepatic stellate cells (HSCs). Effective clinical interventions remain extremely limited, as targeting a single pathological pathway provides only partial benefit and fails to fully arrest disease progression. Herein, by screening a dynamic human liver fibrosis organoid model, we identified miR-3682-3p as a previously unrecognized pro-fibrotic driver that was upregulated during fibrosis progression and associated with disease severity. To enable dual-pathway intervention, we engineered a targeted nanotherapeutic platform based on adipose-derived stem cell exosomes (ADSC-EVs), loaded with a miR-3682-3p inhibitor (in-3682) and surface-decorated with cRGDyk-modified cerium oxide (CeO2) nanozymes. This platform, termed RC@EVs-in3682, preferentially targets activated HSCs and concurrently mitigates oxidative stress and pro-fibrotic signaling, thereby suppressing HSC activation, contraction, and migration. Moreover, in a carbon tetrachloride (CCl4)-induced mouse model of liver fibrosis, RC@EVs-in3682 reduced collagen deposition and restored hepatic architecture. Mechanistically, our findings support that inhibition of miR-3682-3p and CeO2-mediated ROS scavenging together promote the restoration of the peroxisome proliferator activated receptor γ (PPARγ)/PCK1 axis; accordingly, RC@EVs-in3682 restores PPARγ-dependent PCK1 expression and the associated metabolic program. Collectively, our study provides a multifunctional nanoplatform and establishes RC@EVs-in3682 as a promising nanotherapeutic strategy for liver fibrosis by simultaneously targeting oxidative stress and pro-fibrotic signaling.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 肝纤维化是一种进行性肝脏疾病，由持续的氧化应激和肝星状细胞 (HSC) 转录重编程失调驱动。有效的临床干预措施仍然极其有限，因为针对单一病理途径只能提供部分益处，并且无法完全阻止疾病进展。在此，通过筛选动态人肝纤维化类器官模型，我们将 miR-3682-3p 确定为以前未被识别的促纤维化驱动因素，其在纤维化进展过程中上调并与疾病严重程度相关。为了实现双途径干预，我们设计了一个基于脂肪干细胞外泌体 (ADSC-EV) 的靶向纳米治疗平台，该平台装载有 miR-3682-3p 抑制剂 (in-3682)，并用 cRGDyk 修饰的氧化铈 (CeO2) 纳米酶进行表面修饰。该平台被称为 RC@EVs-in3682，优先针对激活的 HSC，同时减轻氧化应激和促纤维化信号传导，从而抑制 HSC 激活、收缩和迁移。此外，在四氯化碳 (CCl4) 诱导的肝纤维化小鼠模型中，RC@EVs-in3682 减少了胶原沉积并恢复了肝脏结构。从机制上讲，我们的研究结果支持抑制 miR-3682-3p 和 CeO2 介导的 ROS 清除共同促进过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体 γ (PPARγ)/PCK1 轴的恢复；因此，RC@EVs-in3682 恢复了 PPARγ 依赖性 PCK1 表达和相关代谢程序。总的来说，我们的研究提供了一个多功能纳米平台，并通过同时针对氧化应激和促纤维化信号传导，将 RC@EVs-in3682 确立为一种有前途的肝纤维化纳米治疗策略。

global_hot_topics.title: Semantic Processing in Unresponsive Patients With Acute Brain Injury.
global_hot_topics.authors: Ayham Alkhachroum; Brian Manolovitz; John McKeown; Ana Bolanos; Elena Mishkovsky; Julia Houshmand; Gabriela Aklepi; Mariana Barrios
global_hot_topics.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Early prognostication after acute brain injury (ABI) is challenging because behavioral responsiveness may not accurately reflect preserved cognitive function. Neural responses to semantic incongruity can identify language processing despite the absence of overt behavior. We investigated whether bedside EEG could detect semantic processing in unresponsive patients with ABI and whether its presence was associated with long-term outcomes. METHODS: In this prospective 2-center cohort study, unresponsive adults with ABI admitted to neurologic intensive care units between 2022 and 2025 underwent bedside EEG during a language paradigm comparing congruent and incongruent sentence endings (e.g., "my favorite color is green/soon"). Semantic processing was defined by differential event-related responses within centroparietal channels (300-500 milliseconds) using cluster-based permutation testing with false discovery rate correction. Outcomes were assessed for recovery of consciousness and functional recovery (Glasgow Outcome Scale-Extended score ≥4) at 12 months by blinded interviewers. Diagnostic performance was evaluated using sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, accuracy, and likelihood ratios. RESULTS: Among 105 patients (mean age 58 ± 19 years; 21% women; 53% Hispanic/Latino), the most common etiologies were intracerebral hemorrhage (45%), traumatic brain injury (43%), and subarachnoid hemorrhage (10%). Withdrawal of life-sustaining therapy occurred in 31%. Semantic processing was detected in 13 patients (12%). Recovery of consciousness occurred in 77% of patients with semantic processing compared with 49% without semantic processing (odds ratio [OR] 3.5; 95% CI 0.9-13.5, p = 0.08). Functional recovery occurred in 42% with semantic processing compared with 14% without semantic processing (OR 4.5; 95% CI 1.2-16.6, p = 0.03). Semantic processing was highly specific but insensitive for predicting both recovery of consciousness (specificity 94%, sensitivity 18%) and functional recovery (specificity 92%, sensitivity 29%). After excluding patients who underwent withdrawal of life-sustaining therapy or died of non-neurologic medical complications, specificity increased to 100% for recovery of consciousness and 95% for functional recovery. DISCUSSION: EEG evidence of semantic processing can be detected in a subset of unresponsive patients with ABI during the acute phase of injury and is associated with favorable long-term outcomes. Semantic processing was a specific but insensitive biomarker of recovery, suggesting potential utility as a rule-in marker of preserved cognitive function. These findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation in larger multicenter cohorts before clinical implementation.

global_hot_topics.title: Decision-Making in Surgical Excision for Colloid Cysts: Redefinition of Colloid Cyst Removal Criteria and Stratification of the Risk Factors of Colloid Cyst Surgery in a Retrospective Analysis of 37 Cases.
global_hot_topics.authors: Müge Dolgun; Murat Hamit Aytar; Mustafa Ali Akçetin; Aslan Güzel; Bülent Düz
global_hot_topics.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Management of third ventricular colloid cysts requires consideration of clinical presentation, ventricular status, cyst anatomy, and the anticipated surgical corridor. We evaluated the Duz Classification, an MRI-based anatomic framework using clearly defined landmarks, and explored its associations with cyst volume, ventricular enlargement, and surgical outcomes. A complementary clinical risk assessment framework is also proposed. METHODS: Thirty-seven unique patients underwent 38 colloid cyst procedures. The Duz Classification defines 4 anatomic types according to the relationship of the cyst to the anterior commissure-posterior commissure line and a vertical plane extending from the mammillary body to the posterior margin of the foramen of Monro. Ventricular status was categorized as no enlargement, ventricular dilatation, or hydrocephalus. Nonparametric tests, exact/permutation methods, effect estimates, and 95% CIs were used. RESULTS: The cohort comprised 37 patients (mean age, 32.1 ± 12.8 years; 18 women) and 38 procedures. Anatomic distribution was Type 1 in 19 patients, Type 2 in 11, Type 3 in 4, and Type 4 in 3. Twenty-four patients (64.9%; 95% CI, 48.8%-78.2%) had ventricular enlargement, including 16 with ventricular dilatation and 8 with hydrocephalus. Ventricular-enlargement severity correlated with cyst volume (ρ = 0.454; 95% CI, 0.139-0.718; P = .0048). After Bonferroni correction, the Type 1 vs Types 3-4 cyst-volume comparison remained significant (adjusted P = .0048). CONCLUSION: The Duz Classification provides a clearly defined MRI-based anatomic framework for characterizing third ventricular colloid cysts. Types 3-4 lesions demonstrated greater cyst volumes and a higher hydrocephalus burden than the other anatomic groups. The proposed complementary risk assessment framework may facilitate structured clinical evaluation and surgical planning but requires prospective validation before use for predicting natural history or determining treatment thresholds.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 背景和目的：第三脑室胶样囊肿的治疗需要考虑临床表现、心室状态、囊肿解剖结构和预期的手术通道。我们评估了 Duz 分类（一种基于 MRI 的解剖框架，使用明确定义的标志），并探讨了其与囊肿体积、心室扩大和手术结果的关系。还提出了补充临床风险评估框架。方法：37 名独特的患者接受了 38 例胶样囊肿手术。 Duz分类根据囊肿与前连合-后连合线以及从乳头体延伸至门罗孔后缘的垂直平面的关系定义了4种解剖类型。心室状态分为无扩大、心室扩张或脑积水。使用非参数检验、精确/排列方法、效应估计和 95% CI。结果：该队列由 37 名患者（平均年龄 32.1 ± 12.8 岁；18 名女性）和 38 例手术组成。解剖分布为 1 型 19 例，2 型 11 例，3 型 4 例，4 型 3 例。24 例患者（64.9%；95% CI，48.8%-78.2%）出现脑室扩大，其中 16 例伴有脑室扩张，8 例伴有脑积水。心室扩大的严重程度与囊肿体积相关（ρ = 0.454；95% CI，0.139-0.718；P = .0048）。 Bonferroni 校正后，1 型与 3-4 型囊肿体积比较仍然显着（调整后的 P = .0048）。结论：Duz 分类为表征第三脑室胶样囊肿提供了一个明确的基于 MRI 的解剖框架。与其他解剖组相比，3-4 型病变表现出更大的囊肿体积和更高的脑积水负担。所提出的补充风险评估框架可能有助于结构化临床评估和手术计划，但在用于预测自然史或确定治疗阈值之前需要进行前瞻性验证。

medical_news.abstract: A new clinical trial found that the ketogenic diet dramatically outperformed Mediterranean and low-fat diets in reducing liver fat and improving metabolic health, even when participants lost similar amounts of weight. medical_news.abstract: Blockbuster weight loss drugs like Ozempic and Mounjaro may do more than help people shed pounds, with growing evidence suggesting they could also influence brain health.
